snippet.title: 🥣 Preparing Traditional Karah Parshad #motivationalvideo #love ❣️✅✅❤️❤️🙏🙏
snippet.description:
Witness the meditative process behind crafting Karah Parshad in a communal kitchen. This video captures the quiet devotion and rhythmic labor involved in preparing this sacred sweet pudding, from the meticulous sifting of flour to the final, steady stirring of the golden mixture over an open flame.

Every motion, from the pouring of rich ghee to the consistent churning with a large metal spatula, reflects a deep commitment to selfless service. The ambient sounds of the kitchen, combined with the gentle, soulful background score, provide a peaceful look at this centuries-old tradition. Join us for a moment of calm and focus as we highlight the artistry and intention poured into every batch of this nourishing offering. Whether you are interested in traditional culinary techniques or the spirit of community service, this glimpse into the kitchen offers a serene experience of shared purpose and dedication.

snippet.title: Ravan Ki Lanka Kahan Thi? 1500 साल पुराना श्लोक, हैरान करने वाला जवाब
snippet.description:
रावण की लंका कहाँ थी? 499 ईसवी में आर्यभट ने आर्यभटीय में लिखा कि लंका भूमध्य रेखा पर, उज्जैन के ठीक दक्षिण में है।
और वाल्मीकि रामायण में राम सेतु की लंबाई 100 योजन है, जो उसी जगह तक पहुँचती है। संयोग या एक ही नक्शा?

इस वीडियो में:
• वाल्मीकि का दिन-ब-दिन हिसाब: 14 + 20 + 21 + 22 + 23 = 100 योजन
• "दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं शतयोजनमायतम्": 10 योजन चौड़ा, 100 योजन लंबा
• किष्किंधा, सुंदर और युद्ध कांड, तीनों में एक ही दूरी
• नल ने सेतु कैसे बनाया: डोरियाँ, नापने के डंडे और यंत्र
• आर्यभट का श्लोक "स्थलजलमध्याल्लङ्का" और उज्जैन से 22.5°
• नक्शे पर वो बिंदु: श्रीलंका से लगभग 850 किमी दक्षिण, रामेश्वरम से लगभग 1100 किमी

ध्यान दें: योजन का माप ग्रंथों में 8 से 11 किमी के बीच बताया गया है, और कई विद्वान आर्यभट की लंका को एक खगोलीय संदर्भ-बिंदु मानते हैं। यह वीडियो एक व्याख्या है, अंतिम निष्कर्ष नहीं।

आप क्या मानते हैं? कमेंट में ज़रूर बताइए।

snippet.title: You won’t believe what Saladin did to the Templars after Hattin…
snippet.description:
The Battle of Hattin in 1187 was a disaster for the Kingdom of Jerusalem, but for the captured Knights Templar and Hospitaller, the worst was still to come.

Saladin ordered the execution of captured members of the military orders, while other prisoners were spared.

His own secretary, Imad al-Din al-Isfahani, recorded the executions and openly celebrated them.

Saladin’s reputation for chivalry has endured for centuries, but the contemporary Christian and Muslim accounts paint a more complicated picture of the man.

Primary Sources

Imad al-Din al-Isfahani, “The Conquest of Jerusalem”

Baha al-Din ibn Shaddad, “The Rare and Excellent History of Saladin”

Peter of Blois, “Passio Raginaldi”

snippet.title: The Underwater Lake That Kills 😨
snippet.description:
More than a mile under the Red Sea, in the Gulf of Aqaba, there is a lake on the seafloor – with its own shore. Deep-sea brine pools like this one are up to eight times saltier than seawater, so heavy that they never mix with the ocean above, and they hold no oxygen at all. Animals that stray in are stunned or killed, and eels and shrimp seem to hunt at the edge for stunned prey. Whatever dies inside can stay preserved for years. Yet the brine is teeming with microbes, its mud holds a record of floods and tsunamis going back about 1,200 years, and scientists say pools like it could hint at life on other planets. This one lies just 2 kilometers from the beach.

Would you swim here? Tell us in the comments.

Sources:
Purkis et al., Communications Earth & Environment (2022) – Discovery of the deep-sea NEOM Brine Pools in the Gulf of Aqaba, Red Sea
University of Miami Rosenstiel School via ScienceDaily (2022, republished Nov 2026)

Visuals are animated illustrations, not to scale. The 3–8× salinity range applies to deep-sea brine pools in general.

snippet.description:
(22 Nov 2026)

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Dymer, Kyiv region, Ukraine - 22 November 2026
1. Wide of first responders and machinery at scene of strike removing debris
STORYLINE:
A Russian attack struck an apartment building in a village near Ukraine's capital on Sunday, killing at least two people and wounding four others, authorities said. 

Nearly a dozen people were feared trapped beneath the rubble.

The morning strike destroyed the five-story building in Dymer, which is north of Kyiv.

Rescuers have evacuated nine people, including a child, authorities said, while another child was hospitalized with injuries. 

Search and rescue teams worked to find other survivors. 

Ukraine’s State Emergency Service said that 11 people were believed to be trapped.

snippet.title: Baby Learning with Ms Rachel - Baby Songs, Speech, Sign Language for Babies - Toddler Learning Video
snippet.description:
Our videos for babies and toddlers teach animal sounds, first words and encourage baby and toddler speech and language development learning. We use techniques recommended by speech therapists. Join us as we learn about pets and animal sounds in this fun “Talking Time” video! After pets, you will see some of our farm animal video and then some slow speech exercises. We hope you find the toddler speech learning exercises, activities and techniques helpful. 

If you think your child may have a speech delay, talk to your pediatrician. You may qualify for free speech therapy through early intervention. You can also get an assessment from a speech therapist. The sooner you get help, the better! 

Just to be clear, we ourselves are not speech therapists. Rachel has a masters in music education and teaches preschool music.  She has also taught many toddler classes. If you are in New York City and are seeking a speech therapist, check out www.chatterboxnyc.com The brilliant speech therapists at Chatterbox are highly recommended and helped with our “Speech Techniques for Toddlers” video. 

We also include toddler songs and baby songs in our toddler speech learning videos. Simple songs can help the development of language and gestures! Gestures and imitation are building blocks that help with language development. We also include some sign language and pretend play. Baby sign language can help with the development of language and will not impede the development of language and speech. We also model pretend play. Pretend play is an important toddler skill. 

In this video we will go over the following animal sounds: Dog, cat, bunny rabbit and farm animals, cow, duck, pig, sheep and horse. Animal sounds are a great way to encourage your child to make sounds and experiment with their voice. A fun toy that may encourage language is a toy barn with toy farm animals. You can get right down on the floor at your child’s level and make the animal sounds. It may help to hold a toy by your mouth so they look at the way your mouth produces the sounds.

This video may also be helpful to children with apraxia, autism, down syndrome and other developmental delays and special needs. We hope the speech activities, exercises, lessons and training are helpful! This video is great for a baby, 1 year old, 2 year old, 3 year old, 4 year old and even older! 

On our channel, we have many more speech practice videos (see our speech playlist) and we also have free preschool class videos (see our preschool class playlist) and full music classes! We have videos for babies, videos for toddlers and videos for kids. Our videos for toddlers are in English. In our videos we work on speech and language, milestones, gestures, pretend play, social emotional learning, dramatic play, art, music, math, science, circle time, finger plays, sensory play and many more activities! We’d love for you to become part of our Songs for Littles family! 

If you are looking for videos for babies, 1 year olds, 2 year olds, 3 year olds, 4 year olds or even 5 year olds, our videos will be excellent choices.

snippet.description:
[앵커]

갑자기 식당 간판이 떨어져내리며 80대 여성이 크게 다치는 사고가 났습니다.

피해자는 전치 20주의 중상해를 입었고 1억 가까이 치료비가 들었지만 피해에 대한 어떤 보상도 받지 못하고 있는데요.

문형민 기자가 단독취재했습니다.

[기자]

한 여성이 식당 문을 열고 밖으로 나옵니다.

잠시 뒤 갑자기 떨어진 식당 간판이 여성을 덮칩니다.

지난달 2일, 서울 성북구의 한 고깃집에서 간판과 철제 구조물이 무너지며 80대 여성이 다쳤습니다.

피해 여성은 의식을 잃은 채 병원으로 옮겨졌고, 전치 20주의 중상해 진단을 받았습니다.

[배중우 / 피해자 아들] “번개, 벼락 맞는 기분이었어요. 출혈이 많고 수혈이 원활히 공급이 안 된 상태였고, 어머니가 의식 돌아온 게 한 25일 정도 지나서예요.”

몇 차례의 수술 끝에 20여일 만에 의식을 회복했지만, 아들의 얼굴도 알아보지 못하고 병원에 입원한 이유도 제대로 알지 못하는 섬망 증세를 겪고 있습니다.

현재까지 치료 비용만 1억 원에 달하는데, 식당에서는 "줄 돈이 없다"며 책임을 회피하고 있습니다.

[배중우 / 피해자 아들] “‘죄송합니다’라고 하지만, 그 말속에 제가 어떤 것도 느껴지지 않고, 약간 웃으면서 얘기하거든요 식당 주인이. 식사나 같이 하시자는 등 이런 얘기를…”

피해자 측은 이달 초 식당 사장은 물론, 건물주와 간판 시공업자를 업무상과실치상 등의 혐의로 경찰에 고소했습니다.

고소인과 일부 피고소인 조사, 그리고 사고 현장조사를 진행 중인 경찰은 추가 조사를 통해 정확한 사고 원인을 규명할 방침입니다.

식당 사장은 연합뉴스TV에 “남은 경찰 조사에 성실하게 임하고 법적 절차에 따르겠다”는 입장을 전했습니다.

연합뉴스TV 문형민입니다.

snippet.title: Shirathal Mustaqim, Jembatan di Atas Jahannam: Siapa yang Selamat? (HR. Muslim 195, Bukhari 7439)
snippet.description:
Shirathal Mustaqim (ash-Shirath) adalah jembatan yang dipasang di atas Jahannam pada hari kiamat. Menurut hadis sahih (Muslim 195, Bukhari 6573 dan 7439), manusia melewatinya sesuai amal mereka: ada yang secepat kedipan mata, kilat, angin, atau kuda yang melesat; ada yang selamat tanpa cedera, ada yang tergores lalu dilepaskan, dan ada yang terjatuh ke Jahannam; yang terakhir hanya sanggup merangkak. Nabi ﷺ berdiri di atasnya berdoa "Rabbi sallim sallim" (Ya Tuhanku, selamatkan, selamatkan). Setelah selamat, orang beriman ditahan di jembatan antara surga dan neraka untuk saling menuntaskan kezaliman, lalu dibersihkan dan diizinkan masuk surga (Bukhari 2440).

Catatan penting:
- Video ini menyusun beberapa hadis sahih (Muslim 182, 183, 195; Bukhari 6573, 7437, 7439, 2440), bukan satu kisah tunggal. Urutan adegan adalah susunan kami, bukan urutan di hadis.
- Semua tokoh, wajah, pakaian, bentuk jembatan, jurang, serta gestur saling memaafkan di akhir adalah ilustrasi buatan AI. Gambaran jembatan sebagai garis cahaya tipis mengikuti riwayat Abu Sa'id, bahwa jembatan itu lebih tipis dari rambut dan lebih tajam dari pedang.
- Orang yang terjatuh digambarkan dengan cahaya yang padam dan menjerit; itu penafsiran visual, bukan lafaz hadis. Yang terjatuh tidak otomatis kafir: penyembah selain Allah sudah dikumpulkan ke neraka sebelum Shirath (Bukhari 7439).
- Rasulullah ﷺ digambarkan dengan oval cahaya sebagai wajah dan tidak berbicara; doanya ada di narasi. Tidak ada dialog karena di hari itu tidak ada yang berbicara kecuali para rasul (Bukhari 7437).
- Istilah dalam hadis adalah ash-Shirath (jembatan). Shirathal Mustaqim adalah istilah Al-Qur'an untuk jalan yang lurus, yang oleh sebagian ulama dikaitkan dengan jembatan ini.
- Visual dan suara dibuat dengan AI (konten sintetik).

Semoga Allah menyelamatkan kita di hari itu dan mengumpulkan kita bersama orang-orang yang beriman.

snippet.description:

snippet.title: „Vorgeschmack auf das, was kommt“: Rekordfluten versetzen Anwohner in Sorge
snippet.description:
Im Westen der USA - wie in Kalifornien - türmen sich die Wellen in Höhe von dreigeschossigen Häusern und nicht nur Uferstraßen werden überflutet. Hervorgerufen durch schwere Stürme weit draußen auf dem Pazifik, deren Ursache auch das natürliche Klimaphänomen El Niño ist. Die sich verändernde Meeresströmungen fallen in diesem Jahr außergewöhnlich stark aus.
